description: Render a template with variables and return the subject, html and text a send would use. Renders the draft unless version is given. Nothing is stored or sent. A missing required variable fails with the keys it needs.

variables.description: Value per {{key}}. Values are inserted as text: HTML-escaped in html, with line breaks removed in the subject.

version.description: Render this published version. Omit to render the current draft.

name: shipmail_preview_template

version.description: The rendered version, or null for the draft.
